svg.title: GL2 character
svg.desc: GL2 SVG mod 0.1.3; live SWF vector paths; no PNG tracing; frame=exported-vector-bounds. Source: chara; paths: 165; timeline masks=4; readback spaces (0=local,1=parent,2=stage): coordinates=0, colors=0, alpha=0. Limitations: AIR normalizes some stroke cap/join/scale properties; AIR readback omits shader fills, triangles and some Flash effects
